meta.title: Monster Energy tracker
meta.description: Counts cans of Monster Energy you log and shows a draggable can card with today's count and the running total. Drag the can anywhere; double-click to reset its position. Bare /monster adds one can, /monster 2 adds two, /monster status shows totals, and /monster undo removes the last entry; counts persist in monster-tracker.json under your DSH home.
